correctness.rationale: Directly deduce the four scattering blocks from the Grover rule on the balanced \(K_{mn,mn}\) Kronecker component and verify four-periodicity. The rank-two coefficient D has squared singular values summing to 1 and multiplying to \(q^2\). Odd-time blocks inherit them, while the two-step block equals a rank-one projector partial transpose with eigenvalues A,B,±sqrt(AB). The full amplitude matrix duplicates all squared singular values. This proves the universal tensor spectrum, all Rényi formulas, rank/equality boundaries and the balanced large-size expansion. The standalone checker independently rebuilt full arc propagation on 11 graph sizes and both exchange signs and passed 572 finite checks; finite checks are not universal proofs.
